title: docs(skills): the data skill teaches the permission-set grant's four-column key and when a grant names permission_set_package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu6oWRUSwxGV9XCnNjvLAvNt)_

Fixes #32539

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:对外发布的 skills 里,「把权限集授予用户」一节的唯一性那句话换了。原来说「每个用户、权限集、组织一条授予,由 `unique: 'organization'` 索引保证」,现在说平台已经落地的规则:唯一键是 `(user_id, permission_set, permission_set_package, organization_id)` 四列;不写包的授予由一条守卫索引保持「每个用户、权限集、组织一条」(`driver-memory` 不建这条守卫);两个包都有同名权限集时,授予在插入时必须写 `permission_set_package`,否则被 `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` 拒收,报文点名每个持有方。
- 为什么改:PR #32306 已合并,授予的键和拒收规则变了,skills 还在教旧键,也从没提过 `permission_set_package`。照着 skills 写授予或种子数据的客户和 AI,在多包环境里遇到同名权限集会被 409 拒收,而 skills 说一条 `unique` 就够。
- 风险与回滚:只改一份 skills 文字,加一个 `@objectstack/skills` 的 patch changeset,不动任何 schema、规则或运行时。文件不变长:新增 4 行由同一文件里删掉的重复内容付清(15834 → 15828 字节,328 → 327 行,token 上限 3959 不动)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`「Assigning a permission set to a user」一节的新四行(教法本体);② 同一文件里为付 token 删掉的六处(下方表格逐条写明每条事实现在住在哪);③ `.changeset/32539-skills-grant-key-package.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期看到 `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md is 3957 tokens (ceiling 3959; headroom 2)`,退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:合并本 PR(`skills/**` 属 Tier H,由你落地)。

## What changes

**1. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`, "Assigning a permission set to a user".** One sentence is replaced.

Before:

> One grant per user, set and organization: enforced by the `unique: 'organization'` index.

After:

> One grant per `(user_id, permission_set, permission_set_package, organization_id)`; a guard index (none on `driver-memory`) holds grants naming no package to one per user, set and organization. Name `permission_set_package` on insert when two packages hold the name, or the grant is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, naming each holder.

Each clause, and where the merged platform says it (PR #32306, `1e474e3d`, changeset `.changeset/32164-permission-set-doors-take-a-package.md`):

| Clause in the skill | The changeset's own words | Merged code |
|:--|:--|:--|
| The four-column key | "the grant's unique key: FROM one grant per `(user_id, permission_set, organization_id)` TO one per `(user_id, permission_set, permission_set_package, organization_id)`" | `indexes` of `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-user-permission-set.object.ts` |
| The guard for grants naming no package | "A grant naming no package (a NULL `permission_set_package`) is exempt from that key; the guard `uniq_sys_user_permission_set_packageless` keeps those to one per `(user_id, permission_set, organization_id)`" | `packages/metadata-protocol/src/migrations/user-permission-set-packageless-index.ts` |
| None on `driver-memory` | "Declared limit: `driver-memory` builds no guard" | `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-user-permission-set-packageless.test.ts` pins the driver's own admission |
| Name the package when two packages hold the name, else `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming each holder | "A set two packages hold, named with no package, at the data door (a non-system writer): … TO `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with the D3 sentence naming every holder" and "naming a holder in `permission_set_package`: … TO stored with exactly that package" | `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/grant-permission-set-name.ts` |
| "on insert" | "a non-system update's `permission_set_package` is still dropped by the engine's `readonly` update strip, never stored and never judged" | the column is `readonly: true` in the object file above |

The skill says "naming each holder" and no more: the changeset states that the `/data` body carries the sentence and that structured candidates on `/data` are a later change, so the skill promises no `details.candidates` there.

**2. A changeset** for `@objectstack/skills` (`patch`).

No eval changes. No file under `skills/objectstack-data/evals/` asserts the old key: the one `unique: 'organization'` hit there is the `employee` e-mail index of `objects-fields-relationships.json`, which is a different rule and still correct.

### Text deleted to pay for the new text, and where each fact still stands

The file sat at its token ceiling with headroom 0 (3959 of 3959), and the new sentence is 336 bytes against the 90 it replaces. Every added byte is paid inside the same file by deleting restatement. No ceiling moves and no line is re-wrapped to buy room.

| Deleted | Where its fact stands |
|:--|:--|
| The bullet "`enable.apiMethods` also restricts the HTTP surface." (it sat in the list of permission-set bits, and is an object key) | `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, "Object Capabilities (`enable`)", the `apiMethods` row: "Whitelist over the six primitives"; `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md`, "Key rule: If your object defines `apiMethods`, only those operations … are exposed" |
| The lead-in "The compiler resolves these `current_user.*` placeholders:" | The table directly under it, whose header is "Placeholder / Resolves to" and whose every row starts `current_user.` |
| The second `// in a permission set` comment (membership-keys example) | The identical comment on the first `rowLevelSecurity` example in the same file, and the section's opening sentence: the policies live "on a permission set / profile" |
| "(`readonlyWhen` likewise strips the write for everyone)" on the field-lock choice | `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, the `readonlyWhen` bullet: "the ObjectQL write path ignores incoming changes when the predicate is `TRUE` (for everyone; per permission set → field permission `when`, rules/security.md)" |
| "Encrypted-at-rest values — " in the bold label of the `secret` paragraph | `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`, the `secret` row: "Reversible **encrypted-at-rest** credential"; the paragraph itself still says "Ciphertext lives in `sys_secret`" and keeps "(ADR-0100)" |
| "A field declaring `requiredPermissions`" becomes "The field" | The bold label of the same sentence: "Per-field access gating — `requiredPermissions` (ADR-0066 D3)." |

## Tests

No test changes: the diff is skill text and a changeset. No behaviour a test pins moves, so there is no ablation.

The behaviour the skill now teaches was read at this head through the pin PR #32306 landed:

<details><summary>The grant door's package rules, at ac3a9829</summary>

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/grant-permission-set-package.test.ts
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  21 passed (21)
```

Its cases include "named with no package: 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT naming both holders, at the data door", "naming a holder in permission_set_package: stored with exactly that package" and "a non-system update's package value is never stored or judged: the readonly column keeps its value".

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **What the sentence leaves out, on purpose.** The token ceiling prices every byte, so the skill carries the three facts the card asks for and nothing else. Not taught here, each stated in `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx` or in the merged changeset: a set one package holds is stamped with its holder when the grant names none; a package that does not hold the set is refused `409` at any holder count; a second grant of one set to one user in one organization is refused through the engine as a duplicate record (`409` `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` on the wire) unless the two name different holders.
- **Declared limits the skill does not carry.** The changeset also declares that MySQL before 8.0.13 and MariaDB before 10.3 keep the old three-column key, as does a MySQL or MariaDB store whose old key rides a hash shadow, and that a grant with no organization is exempt from both indexes. The card's acceptance names `driver-memory` alone, and the docs page names it alone. On those servers the old key refuses more than the skill says, never less.
- **"None on `driver-memory`" is about the index.** Through the engine the write seam still refuses a second grant naming no package on every driver, `driver-memory` included. The skill says the guard index is absent there, which is the changeset's declared limit; it does not say the engine admits the duplicate.
- **Two holders of one name are not reachable today.** The changeset says a real registry cannot hold two packages' sets of one name until a later change, and the same skill file still says "a second package shipping a name is refused at install first" in its positions bullet. The new sentence is conditional ("when two packages hold the name"), so both are true together.
- **The two later merges change nothing this paragraph says.** `7e9f25b7` (an organization administrator's grant naming a package is judged on that holder alone) moves one answer for an administrator who already names the in-boundary holder, which is what the skill now tells an author to do. `6bbdf301` (`os migrate plan` lists the guard) is an operator's reading of a plan, not something a grant author writes. Neither is taught.
- **Nothing from an unmerged pull request is taught.** The stored `permission_set_package` backfill and the other open change on `plugin-security` are not described.
- **The ceiling row is left as it is.** The file now reads 3957 against a ceiling of 3959. The ratchet lets a shrinking PR lower its row; `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is outside this card's file surface, so the row and its comment (which still cites 15834 bytes) are untouched.
